title: a16z Podcast: What Comes After the Smartphone

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Technology is a progression of new ideas and new platforms gobbling up the one that came before.
reader_summary.overview: Technology is a progression of new ideas and new platforms gobbling up the one that came before. In the world of computers we went from mainframes to mini computers to PCs. And then came the mobile phone, which, in the form of the smartphone, has dwarfed them all.

key_points.text: When you have already gotten to everybody on earth, what comes along that is 10X the size?
a16z’s Benedict Evans and Steven Sinofsky offer their thoughts on where technology is today.
a16z and its affiliates may maintain investments in the companies discussed.
